allow.reason: Accessibility TCC cannot be granted to a CI test binary; the live AX tree and element actions need a real desktop session.
ScreenCaptureKit frames need the Screen Recording grant.
Posts real input events and moves the cursor; needs the Post Event grant.
AX menu-bar walk over the Accessibility trust.
AX Dock walk over the Accessibility trust.
NSWorkspace activation/termination and the on-screen window list need a live desktop session.
Reads AX scroll bars during a live scroll.
Opens a click-through window and is compiled out of test builds.
Private SkyLight call, compiled only with the feature and outside test builds.
codesign, AppKit bundle identity, and the TCC responsible-app chain of a signed bundle.
Display, window, and app enumeration need an X server or a portal session.
AT-SPI needs a running accessibility bus and a live application tree.
XDG Desktop Portal capture and RemoteDesktop need a portal daemon and PipeWire.
XTest input needs an X server to post into.
The lazily built tokio runtime is only reached through the AT-SPI and portal paths.
Win32 window enumeration and the integrity token probe need an interactive desktop.
UI Automation needs an interactive desktop session, which a hosted runner does not provide.
Win32 enumeration and process-image lookups need an interactive desktop.
Windows.Graphics.Capture needs a live compositor frame.
Foreground activation and the enigo retry need a real window.
xcap monitor capture needs an enumerable display; the stub backend covers the dispatch.
Event posting for the event tier; the stub backend records the calls instead.
The process-global hold registry only matters over the real input path.
Reads and writes the real system pasteboard; tests inject a stub.
Test scaffolding compiled into test builds only.
On macOS every platform method is implemented by MacOsDesktopBackend, so the trait's default bodies (the uncovered part) cannot execute on this runner. Linux and Windows measure their own defaults.
The module wrappers (capture_window, marks_for_tree, secure_ocr_frames, inspect_accessibility, element_action) need Accessibility or Screen Recording TCC.
